layoutFooter: Local-first sanctions screening — all data stays in this browser

demoFooter.line1: AML-Filter searches public sanctions data entirely in this browser tab. No name you type ever leaves your device.
demoFooter.line2: Data attribution: U.S. Treasury OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN), plus the signed public lists named in the app. Not legal or compliance advice.

workstation.nameExplain: Your name is stamped on review decisions for the audit trail. It is stored only in this browser (a local SQLite settings row) — there is no account and no server.
workstation.watchlistUpdated: Watchlist updated: re-screened {{count}} customer(s) — {{newHits}} new hit(s), {{clearedHits}} cleared.

cacheRecovery.rollbackWarning: The server offered an older version of the screening lists than the one you already have. That can mean someone is tampering with it. Only clear if you trust this.
cacheRecovery.integrityHint: If this keeps happening, clearing the cached lists makes the next load re-download and re-verify every list.
cacheRecovery.confirmPrompt: Clear the cached screening lists on this device? Your customers and reviews are not touched.
cacheRecovery.failed: Could not clear the cached lists: {{detail}}
